title: Equality of maps to a locally finite type target descends
statement: Let $J$ be a small cofiltered category and $D:J\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a diagram of quasi-compact schemes with affine transition maps [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-category-colimit, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Let $t_i:D_i\to S$ be compatible structure maps, and let $(X,\rho_i)$ be a limiting cone. Let $f:Y\to S$ be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. For any $i\in J$ and maps $a,b:D_i\to Y$ with $af=bf=t_i$ and $\rho_i a=\rho_i b$, there exist $k\in J$ and $h:k\to i$ such that $D(h)a=D(h)b$.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Scheme.exists_hom_comp_eq_comp_of_locallyOfFiniteType to D, t, f, the limiting cone and the two maps. Its hypotheses are exactly the stated ones; its index k and arrow h give the claimed equality. No quasi-separatedness is required.
